evidence.evidence_text: Activation Editing, which involves directly editting the internal representations of large language models (LLMs) to alter their behavior and achieve desired properties, has emerged as a promising area of research.
Our method, which we name Householder Pseudo-Rotation (HPR), mimics the rotation transformation, thus preserving activation norm and resulting in an improved performance on various safety benchmarks.
To overcome this shortcoming, we propose a novel editing method that views activations in terms of their directions and magnitudes.
